name: comparative_adjective
description: Produce regular English comparative adjective; matched control produces the unchanged adjective.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
words=['tall','short','long','small','fast','slow','old','young','cold','warm','deep','high','low','light','dark','strong','weak','cheap','rich','poor','hard','soft','thick','quick']
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(96):
 w=words[i%len(words)]; name=random.choice(['English','Grammar','Adjective'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{name} exercise. Write the comparative form.\nbright -> brighter\nshort -> shorter\n{w} ->','answer':' '+w+'er'})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{name} exercise. Copy the adjective unchanged.\nbright -> bright\nshort -> short\n{w} ->','answer':' '+w})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
